messages.en:
{07 14 00}Thanks to you, {04 1f 00},
my house is just the way I
want it now!
{07 00 00}I'm so happy with how it 
turned out, {01 00 00 0a 00}I could just
{01 08 00}{07 01 00}SCREAM!
{07 14 00}You should keep helping
people with your advice, 
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tänu sulle, {04 1f 00},
on mu maja nüüd just
selline, nagu tahan!
{07 00 00}Ma olen tulemusega nii
rahul, {01 00 00 0a 00}et võiksin lausa
{01 08 00}{07 01 00}KARJUDA!
{07 14 00}Sa peaksid inimesi oma
nõuannetega edasi aitama,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I was able to create my 
dream home. {01 00 00 0a 00}It's just
like a healing spa now!
{07 00 00}Thank you so much!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}And
please come over to check
it out and relax sometime!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma suutsin luua oma
unistuste kodu. {01 00 00 0a 00}See on nüüd
nagu tervendav spaa!
{07 00 00}Suur aitäh sulle!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Ja
tule kunagi vaatama
ja lõõgastuma!
